messages:
Priya K: morning — eval-bot flagged a weird regression in the 'pulse' nightly for redwood-amber-3b-q4 on legal-snippets cohort. hallucination score +0.22 vs baseline. attaching quick summary.

 eval-bot: [ALERT] suite=pulse, model=redwood-amber-3b-q4, cohort=legal-snippets, metric=hallucination_rate, delta=+0.22, severity=high. link: https://console.redwood/evals/4598765432

 Miguel R: P2? how noisy is this? :eyes:

 Priya K: starting P2 until we see reproducible failure. it's consistently up across seeds 3/3.

 Jordan L: assigning to me. first step: can someone drop the reproducer and exact eval command?

 Sam T: looks like this started after the q4 rollout yesterday. cf. rollout: redwood-amber-3b -> q4-int4 (variant id: q4a)

 Priya K: repro command:
 ```
 ./eval-run --suite pulse --model redwood-amber-3b-q4 --cohort legal-snippets --seeds 1,2,3 --batch 8 --quant q4
 ```
 Outputs in /evals/4598765432/raw.log

 Jordan L: running reproducer now, will share minimal diff. also will run fp16 baseline.

 Clara S: checking rollout history — we did a canary at 03:30 UTC, full rollout 04:10 UTC. No feature flags changed.

 ops-bot: infra ok — no GPU timeouts or host restarts in the window. (latency/throughput stable)

 Sam T: quick note: q4 kernel update yesterday included a soft-float tweak. might affect prompting with legal snippets (long quoted text).

 Jordan L: initial glance: outputs are truncated mid-sentence more often (seen 17% -> 43%). looks like tokenizer boundary handling when combined with kv-cache & qkernel.

 Miguel R: can we rollback q4a to confirm?

 Priya K: don't rollback yet. Jordan, try fp16 baseline and also q4 with --no-kv-cache.

 Jordan L: fp16 baseline run complete: hallucination delta ~+0.02 (within noise). q4 with --no-kv-cache reduces delta to +0.05. uploading diffs.

 Priya K: OK that points to kv-cache interaction. Sam/Miguel — can you bounce a quick regression test focused on kv-cache+q4 kernels? small matrix: (fp16/int4) x (kv-cache on/off) x prompt-length short/long

 Sam T: on it. ETA 45m.

 Clara S: I've flagged the rollout as paused in the console and notified release manager. :white_flag:

 Miguel R: ping @Jordan when you have the failing sample, we'll open a small PR to add the test-case to nightly.

 Jordan L: posted failing sample and stack snippet in /evals/4598765432/fail_sample.txt

 Priya K: initial severity: P2. owners: @Jordan L (lead), @Sam T (kernel/quant), @Miguel R (test add), @Clara S (release coord). Next actions: Jordan further root cause, Sam to instrument qkernel, Miguel to add regression test, Clara to hold rollout. I'll update incident tracker.

 Sam T: added todo in kernel-queue and started instrument run. :thumbsup:

 ops-bot: note: muted notifications for this thread for the 1st shift. use #eng-ml-incident for noisy logs.

 Priya K: thanks everyone — keep updates short. will reconvene in 1h unless someone finds root cause earlier. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
